Candid iPhone 15 Pro photo, vertical 9:16, shallow depth of field, real skin texture. Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input.
Subject: all positions in this prompt are measured down from the top edge and across from the left edge of the frame. One modern black smartphone held by the viewer, tilted back about 20 degrees from upright with its lit screen facing the camera, centred (x 16% to 84%), running from y 30% down past the bottom edge, close to the camera; it appears once and is the only device in the picture.
Hands: seen from the viewer's own point of view. The left hand, in the lower left (x 12% to 50%, y 72% to 100%), holds the phone from below: its thumb lies along the phone's left edge and is its only visible finger; its other four fingers wrap around the phone's lower back, out of sight behind the phone, with no fingertips showing past the phone's edges; its wrist and mustard-yellow knit sleeve come up from the bottom edge of the frame behind the phone and are out of sight behind it, except the sleeve cuff showing left of the phone's left edge (x 12% to 16%). The other hand is out of frame. The hand and the sleeve stay below the line 62% of the way down from the top of the frame, well below the bubble. No letter touches a thumb, a finger, a hand or a sleeve. Exactly one hand; of its fingers only the thumb shows, plus the sleeve cuff.
Action: The left thumb rests along the phone's left edge and its four hidden fingers grip the phone's lower back; the phone is still.
Props: the phone is a plain black smartphone with thin bezels and rounded corners, no logo on the case or the glass, one lit screen. The screen shows a plain chat view on a white background with exactly one large light-grey incoming message bubble at the top of the screen (x 22% to 78%, y 33% to 54%), and empty white space below it; no names, no avatars, no status bar, no time, no app logo.

No hand, finger, sleeve rises above the line 62% of the way down from the top, so no letter touches anything.
Setting: a home office in the evening seen over the hands: a warm walnut desk visible only in the strips left and right of the phone, soft and out of focus; above the phone's top edge there is only the wall, plain dark warm grey and out of focus. No other screens, papers, posters or readable words anywhere except the message in the bubble; the desk is bare.
Camera: first person looking down at the phone at about 30 degrees, phone screen sharp, 9:16. The top 30% of the frame is a calm, plain, out-of-focus dark wall with nothing in it.
